title: Welcome to Tic Tac Toe AI!
body: Challenge our AI across three difficulty levels — easy, medium, and hard (unbeatable minimax). Pick a personality for some extra drama.

title: Hard Mode is Unbeatable
body: Think you can crack a perfect minimax engine? Hard mode has never lost and never will. Draws are the best you can hope for.

title: Leaderboard: Points System
body: You earn 3 points per win, 1 per draw, and 0 for a loss. Tiebreakers use win rate. Climb the board!

title: Voice Commentary Is Here
body: The AI can now read its trash talk out loud using your browser's text-to-speech engine. Click the speaker icon during a match.

title: Profile Customization Unlocked
body: You can now set a display name, bio, favorite difficulty, favorite AI personality, and more on your Profile page.
